title: DemoContractsCommon
description: Shared definitions of the operator console contract v1. This file is a definitions container: validate against one named definition (for example common#/$defs/source_stamp), never against this root.

id.title: Id
id.description: An opaque identifier minted by the runtime. Never a hostname, a robot id, a camera id or a device serial.

contract_version.title: ContractVersion
contract_version.description: The major version of this contract. A consumer of v1 refuses any other value instead of guessing.

reason_code.title: ReasonCode
reason_code.description: A stable machine-readable code. The human-readable sentence travels separately.

digest.title: Digest
digest.description: A content identity: lowercase hex, 12 to 64 digits, optionally prefixed sha256:. A short identity is allowed; a path or a file name is not.

clock_domain.title: ClockDomain
clock_domain.description: Which clock a timestamp or a duration was read from. Values from different domains are never subtracted from each other.

data_mode.title: DataMode
data_mode.description: Where the data comes from. Separate from the link state on purpose: a live view whose link dropped is still live, not replay.

nullable_data_mode.title: NullableDataMode
nullable_data_mode.description: A data_mode that may not have been recorded. null means the record predates the field and says nothing; it is never read as live.

clock_relation.title: ClockRelation
clock_relation.description: A MEASURED relation between two clock domains, and the only thing that licenses expressing a time read in one of them in the other. Nothing produces one today: until one exists an age that would need it stays null beside the reason it could not be taken. uncertainty_ns is required and never null, because a relation that cannot state how wrong it may be does not license a subtraction either.

domains.description: The ordered pair this relation is about: offset_ns is added to a time read in the first domain to express it in the second. A consumer checks this pair against the two domains it wants to subtract before it uses the relation at all.

nullable_wall_utc.title: NullableWallUtc
nullable_wall_utc.description: UTC wall time, RFC 3339 with a Z suffix, for display only. Ordering uses seq; durations use t_mono_ns within one clock domain.

safe_text.title: SafeText
safe_text.description: Free text for an operator's screen. The emitter sanitizes it; the schema is the tripwire: a home-directory path or a dotted-quad address fails validation.

not.description: a home-directory path or a dotted-quad address
a home-directory path or a dotted-quad address

named_value.title: NamedValue
named_value.description: One named scalar of a sanitized summary. A string value is restricted to a character set that cannot spell a path, a URL or an endpoint, and may not be a dotted quad.

model_identity.title: ModelIdentity
model_identity.description: A name for the model, such as a registry id with a revision. Never where it was loaded from: a URL, a home-directory path or an address fails validation. A relative path cannot be told from a registry id and is the emitter's to keep out.

not.description: a URL, a home-directory path or a dotted-quad address

source_stamp.title: SourceStamp
source_stamp.description: Identifies one sample at its source: the producing session, the source's own sequence number and, when the source recorded it, the source's monotonic sample time.

provenance.title: Provenance
provenance.description: What a derived value rests on. reconstructed is true when the value was derived with constants that were not recorded with the run; such a value is shown as reconstructed, never as recorded.

module_generation.description: Reserved for Cake: the generation of the module that produced the value. null everywhere today.
